newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures end with small gains.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures end with small gains.

text.p: CME lumber futures drifted on both sides of previous levels in thin dealings before ending slightly higher, buoyed by the nearby contracts' discount to cash lumber prices, traders said.

Interest in futures remained thin as the market awaited direction from the cash market. Wholesalers are discounting wood to move lumber while mills are generally holding firm on asking prices due to fairly large order files, traders said.
Lumber closed $0.50 to $2.60 higher with May up the least at $398.00 and July up $1.10 at $397.60 per tbf.
